title: VooPoo Argus G4 Mini Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus G4 Mini Pod Kit packs exceptional performance into a highly portable and durable aluminium alloy body. Designed for vapers who demand reliability without the bulk of a full-sized mod, this compact device houses a remarkably large 1650mAh internal battery. This high-capacity power source easily defies the small footprint of the kit, providing extended longevity to keep you vaping longer between charges. When you are running low, the device supports efficient Type-C charging to get you back up and running swiftly. Delivering a flexible power output ranging from 5W to 30W, the Argus G4 Mini ensures a perfectly tailored draw every time. It is fully compatible with the innovative Argus Multi-Ohm Cartridge series, which utilises a highly convenient top-fill system. This practical design allows for quick, clean maintenance without the need to detach the pod from your device. Engineered with Voopoo's advanced iCOSM CODE 2.0 technology, these pods feature a multi-core electrode structure that guarantees exceptionally smooth atomisation and consistently vibrant flavour from your chosen e-liquids. Whether you prefer a tight mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw or a looser restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) inhale, the Argus G4 Mini accommodates both styles with ease. Seamlessly inhale-activated and highly effective with both nicotine salts and standard 50/50 e-liquids, it is the ultimate versatile daily vape. Check out our vape juices and pair them perfectly with this kit. We recommend using the following E-Liquid: Voopoo Argus Multi-Ohm (1.0ohm, 0.7ohm) Pod - For 1.0ohm & 0.7ohm use Nic salts E-liquids Voopoo Argus V2 0.4ohm Pod - Use high VG E-Liquid (sub-ohm) - Choose Double Drip. Voopoo Argus V2 0.7ohm Pod - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 (freebase) - Choose Bar Salts. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
